Definition: Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt
BiblicalUsage: Egypt = "land of the Copts"; n pr loc; 1) a country at the northeastern section of Africa, adjacent to Palestine, and through which the Nile flows; Egyptians = "double straits"; adj; 2) the inhabitants or natives of Egypt
